dropped.item: Tagline 'A little measuring done. A little joy delivered.' (mostly flourish, but it framed the product as reducing effort and delivering joy)
Section headings 'Less measuring. More making.', 'Make room for a monthly bake.', and 'One kit. $34 a month.' (their content is carried in the body text)
The explicit benefit framing that pre-measuring leaves 'more time' for stirring, baking, and tasting

changed.item: 'so you can get straight to the good part' became 'so you can start at the mixing'. The vague benefit is now a specific step.
'Give yourself something to look forward to each month' (an invitation to the reader) became 'Each month gives you a bake to look forward to' (a statement about the product)
'One kit. $34 a month.' became 'Each kit is $34 a month', which slightly blurs the per-kit vs. subscription pricing

added.item: 'start at the mixing' names mixing as the first step, which the original did not state
